definitions.explanation: Standing perfectly straight and vertical. Used for people standing at attention, trees growing straight, or anything positioned vertically.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{直立|ちょくりつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{敬礼|けいれい}→敬礼：19877_keirei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The soldier stood at attention and saluted.

examples.japanese: {直立|ちょくりつ}⟦{不動|ふどう}→不動：11632_fudou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}っていた→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: He was waiting standing rigidly at attention.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人類|じんるい}→人類：01578_jinrui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{直立|ちょくりつ}⟦{二足歩行|にそくほこう}→二足歩行：29490_nisokuhokou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{数百万年|すうひゃくまんねん}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことだ。
examples.english: Humans began upright bipedal walking several million years ago.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in the set phrase {直立|ちょくりつ}⟦{不動|ふどう}→不動：11632_fudou⟧ (standing rigidly at attention), which describes a military-style posture of standing perfectly still and upright. Also commonly used in scientific contexts when discussing human evolution and bipedal locomotion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {直立|ちょくりつ}⟦{不動|ふどう}→不動：11632_fudou⟧: standing rigidly at attention
- {直立|ちょくりつ}⟦{二足歩行|にそくほこう}→二足歩行：29490_nisokuhokou⟧: upright bipedal walking
- {直立|ちょくりつ}⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: upright posture
- {直立|ちょくりつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to stand upright
